interpretation: Stratified benchmark, not the natural frequency distribution of endgames or a measure of Elo

source.selection: Seeded row-group order; one accepted root per source game; balanced piece-count/side/W-D cells; no NN outputs used
source.symmetry: Each game deterministically selects identity or color/rank mirror; original FEN retained. No random piece placements.
source.source_filter_bias: Upstream is_tablebase counts piece letters over the whole FEN, so the side-to-move b omits true 5-piece Black roots. Source evaluations converted White -> STM before any mirror.
source.reader: pyarrow 21.0.0 installed in isolated utility target; model environment unchanged
source.integrity_limit: Selected ranges hashed and immutable GCS generation pinned; full 1.4GB object not downloaded or claimed fully hashed

counters: Effective halfmove=0/fullmove=1; original source FEN preserved; theoretical WDL ignores fifty-move rule
groups: One root per source game globally, valid symmetry groups disjoint; exclude all old 13,072 roots plus 221 development groups
test_usage: New selected test roots: no project NN outputs inspected before split freeze; old inspected benchmark retained unchanged; use validation for model choices
labels: Independent local Syzygy WDL and all legal-child outcomes; verify against published root label; DTZ root diagnostic only
